about.title: About us
about.lead: Jelar Shad collects real people's experiences of where to eat what in Bangladesh.

s1.p: “Where can I get good doi?” is usually answered by someone you know. Jelar Shad keeps those answers in one place for everyone: people tell us how it was, and others go with that trust.

s2.p: No stars or scores. People who ate there say whether they loved it, found it okay, or did not like it. Facts like the address, price and whether it is open are checked by others, and we show when something may be out of date.

s3.p: We never push a shop up for money and never make up reviews or ratings. The Famous for lists are picked by editors, not ratings, and every page says so.

s4.p: A shop missing? Saw something wrong? Sign in with Google to add a place or send a correction. Every contribution earns passport points and district stamps.

policy.title: Privacy and rules
policy.lead: We keep only what we need. What we keep and why, in plain words.

s1.p: When you sign in with Google or Facebook we receive your name, photo and email. The email is never shown to anyone. Your name and the experiences, comments and photos you add are public. You decide whether your name appears on the contributors list.

s2.p: Sign-in lets each person share one experience per food and helps us stop abuse. It is not for showing ads or selling your data.

s3.p: You are responsible for the photos and comments you add. Do not post other people's photos, or anything offensive or false. We may hide or remove content after a report, and repeated rule-breaking can lead to a ban.

s4.p: A few cookies and browser storage keep you signed in and remember your theme; your recent searches stay in your browser only. To learn what helps and what breaks, we keep our own anonymous counts (pages opened, searches made, errors that happened). They hold no name, account, IP address or cookie, and records older than 90 days are deleted. There are no advertising cookies and no outside trackers.

s5.p: "Near me" asks for your permission in the browser; your location is used once to find nearby neighbourhoods and is not stored. Neighbourhood centre points come from OpenStreetMap. If you turn on streak reminders we keep a notification address for your device; turning them off deletes it. To stop floods of requests the server briefly counts requests per address in memory; this is never written down.

s6.p: You can take back any experience yourself. To delete your whole account and data, tell us at the address below and we will remove it as soon as we can.
